decisions.rationale: syn-e4 narrates working well with design, customer support, and engineering partners to deliver three shared releases, which is the cross-functional partnership pattern in the applicant's own words without labelling the partnerships as trusted, so the behavioral rule gives TAILORING_ONLY and it independently answers the requirement. syn-e6 narrates coordinating partners and assigning owners, a different action toward the same people (organizing work rather than building partnerships), and adds nothing decisive since a longer citation list does not increase strength.
